method.load_detection: MOV ES, word ptr [absolute CONST slot] in each MAPSYM member context packet
method.relocation_source: NE relocation chain sites in DGROUP segment 10 of assets/SIMANTW.EXE
method.symbol_attribution: first ES access after the earliest code-order load, mapped through that NE target segment and MAPSYM public extents; context.py --data extents are recorded for each public
method.access_attribution: linear ES memory instructions after each slot load until the next ES load/LES; each instruction is kept with bytes and decoded operands
